text_en: Therefore, brothers and sisters, holy partners in a heavenly calling, consider that Jesus, the apostle and high priest of our confession,
text_cn: 所以，有分于天上召选的诸圣弟兄啊！你们应细心想想，我们公认的钦使和大司祭耶稣，

text_en: was faithful to the one who appointed him, just as Moses also “was faithful in all God’s house. ”
text_cn: 对那委派他的是怎样忠信，正如“梅瑟在他的全家中”一样。

text_en: Yet Jesus is worthy of more glory than Moses, just as the builder of a house has more honor than the house itself.
text_cn: 他本来比梅瑟堪受更大的光荣，就如修建房屋的人，比那房屋理当更受尊荣。

text_en: (For every house is built by someone, but the builder of all things is God. )
text_cn: 不错，每座房屋都由一个人修建，但那创造万有的却是天主。

text_en: Now Moses was faithful in all God’s house as a servant, to testify to the things that would be spoken later.
text_cn: 梅瑟在天主的全家中的确忠信，不过他只是臣仆，为给那当要宣布的事作证；

text_en: Christ, however, was faithful over God’s house as a son, and we are his house if we hold firm the confidence and the pride that belong to hope.
text_cn: 但基督却是儿子，管理自己的家；他的家就是我们，只要我们保存由望德所生的依恃和荣耀，【坚定不移，直到最后。】

text_en: Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says, “Today, if you hear his voice,
text_cn: 为此，圣神有话说：“今天你们如果听从他的声音，

text_en: do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion, as on the day of testing in the wilderness,
text_cn: 不要再心硬了，像在叛乱之时，像在旷野中试探的那一天；

text_en: where your ancestors put me to the test, though they had seen my works
text_cn: 在那里，你们的祖宗以考验试探了我，虽然见了我的作为，

text_en: for forty years. Therefore I was angry with that generation, and I said, ‘They always go astray in their hearts, and they have not known my ways. ’
text_cn: 共四十年之久。所以我厌恶了那一世代，说：他们心中时常迷惑，他们不认识我的道路，

text_en: As in my anger I swore, ‘They will not enter my rest. ’”
text_cn: 所以我在怒中起誓说：他们决不得进入我的安息。”

text_en: Take care, brothers and sisters, that none of you may have an evil, unbelieving heart that turns away from the living God.
text_cn: 弟兄们！你们要小心，免得你们中有人起背信的恶心，背离生活的天主；

text_en: But exhort one another every day, as long as it is called “today, ” so that none of you may be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
text_cn: 反之，只要还有“今天”在，你们要天天互相劝勉，免得你们有人因罪恶的诱惑而硬了心，

text_en: For we have become partners of Christ, if only we hold our first confidence firm to the end.
text_cn: 因为我们已成了有分于基督的人，只要我们保存着起初怀有的信心，坚定不移，直到最后。

text_en: As it is said, “Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion. ”
text_cn: 经上所说：“今天你们如果听从他的声音，不要再心硬了，像在叛乱之时，”

text_en: Now who were they who heard and yet were rebellious? Was it not all those who left Egypt under the leadership of Moses?
text_cn: 是谁听了而起了叛乱呢？岂不是梅瑟从埃及领出来的众人吗？

text_en: But with whom was he angry forty years? Was it not those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
text_cn: 四十年之久，天主厌恶了谁呢？不是那些犯了罪，而他们的尸首倒在旷野中的人吗？

text_en: And to whom did he swear that they would not enter his rest, if not to those who were disobedient?
text_cn: 他向谁起了誓，不准进入他的安息呢？不是向那些背信的人吗？

text_en: So we see that they were unable to enter because of unbelief.
text_cn: 于是我们看出：他们不得进入安息，是因了背信的缘故。
